title: Refund Terms Schedule, Wayfare Bikes and Scooters
content:
Refund terms of the Wayfare Bikes and Scooters plans: the time limits and settings that bike charge refunds turn on, and where refunds are paid.

## Schedule

| Plan | Malfunction reporting window (elapsed hours after the ride ends) | Overtime caused by a dock that failed to lock the vehicle is refunded | Lost vehicle fee refunded in full if the vehicle is recovered undamaged within (calendar days of the unlock) | Refunds paid to | Ride history window (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Bikes Pay As You Ride | 48 | Yes | 7 | the original payment method | 90 |
| Wayfare Bikes Day Pass | 48 | Yes | 7 | the original payment method | 90 |
| Wayfare Bikes Monthly Pass | 48 | Yes | 7 | the original payment method | 90 |
| Wayfare Bikes Access Annual | 48 | Yes | 7 | the original payment method | 90 |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual | 48 | Yes | 7 | the original payment method | 90 |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual Plus | 48 | Yes | 7 | the original payment method | 90 |

## Definitions

- **Malfunction reporting window:** the hours after a ride ends within which a malfunction must be reported for a refund of that ride, counted in elapsed hours.
- **Dock failure:** whether overtime caused by a dock that failed to lock the vehicle is refunded. It is refunded on every plan.
- **Lost vehicle recovery:** a lost vehicle fee is refunded in full when the vehicle is recovered undamaged within 7 calendar days of the unlock.
- **Refund destination:** refunds return to the original payment method.
- **Ride history window:** the days of ride history the rider can see in the app and that support can refund against, in calendar days.

## Basis questions answered

**Where is a Wayfare Bikes and Scooters refund paid?** To the original payment method, on every plan.

**How long after a ride ends may a malfunction be reported for that ride's refund?** Within 48 elapsed hours. A report made 30 hours after a hypothetical ride ended is within the window; a report made 60 hours after is not.

**What period does the lost vehicle recovery count from?** From the unlock, in calendar days: a vehicle unlocked on a hypothetical 3 May and recovered undamaged on 6 May is recovered within 7 calendar days of the unlock; one recovered on 20 May is not.

**How far back does the ride history reach?** 90 calendar days, the same history the rider sees in the app.
